_doc: Hub activity tuning (docs/design/HUB.md §3, docs/HUB_SYSTEMS.md §5). Bag points use the combat damage formula (closing speed quality q and contact cleanliness): base = move damage x (0.55 + 0.6 q) x (0.75 + 0.25 clean) x (1 + charge x charge_damage); points = base x points_per_damage x class multiplier (Heavy x1.5, Finisher x2) x combo multiplier (+combo_step per hit landed within combo_window s, capped). Tiers pay Clout once per tier (bags: once per tier per fighter).

light.name: Light bag
light.desc: Speed: every hit counts, quick strings build the combo faster.

heavy.name: Heavy bag
heavy.desc: Power: closing speed and charge are everything.

body.name: Body bag
body.desc: Shaped like the Commissioner. Only head and shell hits count.
